items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Punch we had Allen. We had Allen. We had Tucker.

ctx.x: Punch we had Allen. We had Allen. We had Tucker. They tell me Tucker's feeling better now. Yeah, that's good. They don't drink anymore.
How old was Allen at that time? Red Allen. Mm-hmm. How old was Red Allen then? I don't know.
